{{Top|leg}}
'''Anawa''' was a colonization corporation. Their scouts were known for discovering new hospitable planets, and these scouts would serve as administrators and police as the colony formed. Anawa scouts were also expected to patrol nearby [[Star system/Legends|systems]] to protect colonists from any dangers. It is known that they were in operation during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], when they offered those seeking refuge from the "dark times" a way into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].
